We have been shocked to witness the Russian government’s horrific invasion of Ukraine unfold. At IVP, we stand in solidarity with Ukraine and condemn Russia’s unprovoked attack on its land and people. Our hearts go out to the millions of Ukrainians affected by the invasion, and we seek to support those suffering as a result of this humanitarian crisis.

IVP is donating more than $100,000 to organizations including:
* [World Central Kitchen](https://web.archive.org/web/20220308230540/https://wck.org/relief/activation-chefs-for-ukraine) to provide meals to Ukrainians in major cities like Odessa and Kyiv and to those who have been forced to leave their homes and are seeking refuge in southern Poland
* [Doctors without Borders](https://web.archive.org/web/20220308230540/https://www.doctorswithoutborders.org/what-we-do/news-stories/story/ukraine-we-are-calling-respect-human-life) to ensure that essential medical supplies and emergency health care get to the sick and elderly in the region   
* [Ukrainian Red Cross](https://web.archive.org/web/20220308230540/https://redcross.org.ua/en/donate/) to deliver meals and hygiene packages to Ukrainians affected by the war and to those who have been forced to leave their homes and seek refuge in Eastern Europe.

In addition, we are humbled by the overwhelming generosity of portfolio companies like Grammarly and Veriff, who have donated resources to the Ukrainian people. We will continue to stand with them during this time.

*The IVP Team*
